title: Harry Styles Rewinds to His 2010 Audition for Harryween
summary:
Harry Styles took a trip back in time at Madison Square Garden on Friday, October 30 — and he brought the audience with him.

On the 29th night of his 30-show Together, Together residency, Styles changed mid-show into the outfit he wore for his 2010 X Factor audition. Then he sang Stevie Wonder's 'Isn't She Lovely,' the song that helped him move on to the next round when he was 16. He even repeated a line from that day, telling the crowd, 'I work in a bakery,' a nod to the part-time job he held in his hometown of Holmes Chapel in Cheshire.

The throwback was not the night's only costume change. Styles opened the show dressed as Elvis Presley, while his band and dancers came dressed as different versions of Styles from across his career. The Elvis choice made sense: the first song Styles ever recorded was a cover of Presley's 'The Girl of My Best Friend.'

The audition story has a twist. 'Isn't She Lovely' was not Styles' first pick. Footage released by the show in 2022 showed he opened with Train's 'Hey, Soul Sister,' and only sang the Wonder song without a backing track after Simon Cowell asked to hear him that way. He was later placed in One Direction alongside Niall Horan, Louis Tomlinson, Zayn Malik and the late Liam Payne.

Costumed covers have become a Harryween tradition. At the first edition, at Madison Square Garden in 2021, Styles dressed as Dorothy to sing 'Over the Rainbow,' then came out as a clown the next night to cover Britney Spears' 'Toxic.' In 2022, at Los Angeles' Kia Forum, he dressed as Grease's Danny Zuko for 'Hopelessly Devoted to You.'

The residency wraps Saturday, October 31, with a final Harryween show.
why_it_matters: It shows how an early audition moment can stay part of a performer's story years later, as artists and audiences revisit beginnings while a residency builds its own traditions.

A throwback is something from the past that is brought back or remembered.
An edition is one occurrence of an event that happens again and again.

background_read: The X Factor is a singing competition where hopeful performers sing in front of an audience and are either sent on to the next round or sent home.
Harry Styles first became widely known through that show, where he was placed with other young singers to form the group One Direction.
After the group, Styles built a solo career as a performer who tours and records his own music.
Harryween is his Halloween-themed concert tradition, where he dresses in costume and performs cover songs connected to that costume.
